description: A common superficial bacterial skin infection that is contagious.
causes: Usually Staphylococcus aureus and/or Streptococcus pyogenes

appearance.general: Superficial erosions and characteristic honey-coloured crusts are common; bullous forms produce flaccid blisters.

warning_signs: Rapid spread, fever, extensive lesions, or signs of deeper infection require medical assessment.
prevention: Keep lesions clean and covered when practical.
Avoid sharing towels, clothing, and personal items.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss whether other household members are affected and whether there is recurrent infection.
